description: Persisted rotation cursor for audit-fix workflow (AFX-E01). The agent reads this at the start of each run, audits the focus_area, then advances current_index (mod length). Changes are committed with the audit PR so the next run picks up the new position.

focus_areas.name: components
focus_areas.description: React UI components — props validation, accessibility, performance

focus_areas.name: hooks
focus_areas.description: Custom React hooks — dependency arrays, cleanup, error handling

focus_areas.name: lib
focus_areas.description: Library/utility code — pure functions, edge cases, types

focus_areas.name: api-routes
focus_areas.description: API route handlers — input validation, error responses, auth checks

focus_areas.name: app-pages
focus_areas.description: App pages, layouts, and non-API routes — data fetching, loading states

focus_areas.name: types
focus_areas.description: TypeScript type definitions — completeness, correctness, exports
